title: 122 pres. TRIPOLISM @ Palma de Mallorca (ES)
sourceDescription:
The event takes place at AMØK CLUB Palma de Mallorca, not at Bootshaus!

Tripolism, three friends from Copenhagen, bring melodic house, indie dance and euphoric techno together — playful, driving, melancholic. Their track "Dope Dance" became one of Pete Tong's top 5 Essential New Tunes of the year, and 2025 saw them hit the Coachella lineup. Opening the night, the German B2B duo Jean Philippe & Mole deliver punchy, organic grooves between Afro House and melodic house, with chart hits like "You Got The Love" on MAJA Records and festival stages including MYLE.

23:45 - TILL LATE
